physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the diaphragm, the slow dome of muscle that lives between the chest and the belly, the floor of the lungs and the ceiling of the gut. It moves without being told to, all day and all night, the most patient muscle a person owns. It is fitting. This is the code of who leads and who follows, and the diaphragm is the part of the body that has already solved it: a single muscle that does not announce itself, and the whole life rests on its rhythm.

The shadow has a bodily floor here. When a person is pulled by another's certainty, or pulling at others to need them, the breath tightens high in the chest and the diaphragm forgets to drop. The belly stops moving. Air gets taken in the way orders get taken, from the top, shallow, never reaching the lower rooms. Long stretches of that leave an ache under the ribs, a held thing that will not fully exhale. The body is telling the truth about the sorting.

The climb out is also bodily, and it is small. The breath lengthens at the bottom before the mind notices. The belly softens. Something inside the trunk lets down by a finger's width. Guidance, before it is anything anyone says, is this. A person whose diaphragm has dropped is a person other people can settle near. The spring rises in the body first.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the muscle, this code answers to a single amino acid, Valine. Valine belongs to the small group the body cannot make for itself. It must be taken in, carried across the mouth from somewhere outside, broken down, and only then put to work. It is one of the few that goes directly to muscle, where the slow continuous work of holding and moving gets done.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the same teaching the card has been speaking the whole way down. The code of leading and following runs on a chemistry that had to be received before it could lead anything. Even the muscle that holds the breath of a life is built from something brought in from outside. Nothing about authority is self-made. Not the inner kind, not the kind a room recognises.

The spring under the ground is also fed from above, by rain that fell somewhere else and travelled. The code runs all the way to this: a guidance that must be taken in before it can be given.
